You can create an exemption so recommendations do not aggregate the `pod` label on any metric.

- You opened **Configuration** and clicked **Add new exemption**.
- You turned **All** on for the metric and set **Keep labels** to `pod`.
- You clicked **Save**, and the exemption is in the list on **Configuration**.

The same fields are available with the API and with Terraform when you already manage Adaptive Metrics as code. Refer to [Adaptive Metrics HTTP API](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/manage-as-code/adaptive-metrics-api/) and [Adaptive Metrics Terraform provider](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/manage-as-code/adaptive-metrics-terraform-provider/).

If you still want the wider Adaptive Metrics flow, take [Optimize your metrics with Adaptive Metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/adaptive-metrics/).
